messages.businessImpact: Reporting counts the same machine several times, and a stale duplicate can show as non-compliant while the live record is healthy, so investigations start in the wrong place.
remediation: Remove the stale records, keeping the one that is checking in.
Duplicates usually come from rebuilds without retirement, so review the rebuild process.
messages.cannotSee: Duplicates are matched on the device name, so two genuinely different machines built with the same name are counted as one record twice over, and a rebuild that changed the name is not matched at all.
